welcome.title: Welcome to Wavebook
welcome.libraryDescription: Browse by song, artist, album, or genre.
welcome.featureDescription: Adjust playback with the equalizer and ReplayGain. With offline lyrics and optional online search.
welcome.folderAccessDescription: Wavebook scans only selected folders. Audio files are not moved or deleted.
welcome.chooseFoldersAccessibilityHelp: Choose one or more local folders to scan.
welcome.exitAccessibilityHelp: Open Wavebook without selecting music folders.
